text.p: BEC Group Inc said Tuesday it had filed suit in Dallas County, Texas, against American Greetings Corp seeking damages in excess of $18 million.
BEC said the suit relates to American Greetings's proposed purchase of BEC's former Foster Grant Group unit.

BEC and American Greetings entered into a letter of intent last August regarding the sale of the Foster Grant Group. In September, American Greetings announced that it would not proceed with the transaction.

BEC said the suit alleges breach of the parties' confidentiality agreement, unfair competition, defamation, tortuous interference with contractual relationships, fraud and misrepresentation, and breaches of warranty and the duty of good faith and fair dealing.
The suit names as defendants American Greetings, its senior vice president Erwin Weiss, and its Magnivision Inc subsidiary.
